_doc: What each minor armour slot guards against (bug bash 3.3.2; docs/design/ARMOR_REDESIGN_PLAN.md section 7; src/guards.py). The minor slots give no AC: each owns one FAMILY of attack, read from the attack's delivery (tools/content/tag_attack_delivery.py), damage type and rider. A matching attack's damage is partly turned aside and its rider (status) partly shrugged off. Narrow guards (one rider, one delivery) were priced by tools/balance/armor_model.py and could not reach a fifth of an AC point, so every family is broad.

base_by_weight_class._doc: What any piece of the slot guards, enchanted or not, by its template's weight class: rider = chance to shrug off a matching rider, damage = share of a matching attack's damage turned aside. Small: the enchantment is the power.
